hero.headline: Your business can't keep running on group chats
hero.subhead: OwlyDev builds the central system that replaces the workarounds and puts you back in control.

items.headline: Pricing set before work starts
items.copy: No scope creep, no surprise invoices. Cost and timeline are fixed in writing before a single line gets coded.

items.headline: Your code, your domain, always
items.copy: The codebase, the domain, and the admin panel are registered to you from day one. No lock-in, no leverage.

items.headline: Built for the team using it
items.copy: Every screen is built for the person who will actually click it daily. No developer training, no 80-page manual.

items.headline: ROI identified before we quote
items.copy: Before proposing anything, we map which manual process costs the most. The software fixes that first.

items.headline: Custom admin panels and dashboards
items.hook: If your team runs on group chats and spreadsheets, every day without a system is a mistake waiting to happen.
items.copy: A central system where your whole team operates: inventory, orders, reports, and metrics in one screen. Built for your business, not for a demo.

items.headline: E-commerce with integrated operations
items.hook: Running an online store while managing inventory somewhere else means operating with one hand tied.
items.copy: An online store connected directly to inventory, fulfillment, and billing. No more exporting spreadsheets between platforms.

items.headline: AI integrated into your existing systems
items.hook: AI doesn't require replacing what already works. It requires connecting to what you already have.
items.copy: Automations, chatbots, and data analysis working inside the tools you already have. No new platforms, no retraining your team.

pricing.heading: The mess has a price too
pricing.disclaimer: Prices are starting points. Every project is scoped and quoted individually.
